subject: EDIT texture-opus in nord2_metal_bridge.c clear_pixel (1 hunk): BGR10A2 (94) CPU clear pixel swaps R/B fields
body: Since #9 BGR10A2Unorm (94) is a render target; clear_pixel's default memcpy wrote n2r_clear's tile word (R in bits 0-9) into BGR10A2 memory (B in bits 0-9). Added a 94 case swapping the 10-bit R/B fields (RT descriptor swizzle 0x60a does the same for GPU writeback). R16F/RG16F/RGB10A2 defaults are already correct (low bytes = first channel). Bridge test rebuilt and PASS (ASan). MATRIX.md regenerated (gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/MATRIX.md) with private/IOSurface/type/usage sections.
